CustomField.description: Single Zone Value based on the Zone 1-6 checkboxes. Used for reports and views of a zone summary for a target.
CustomField.formula: IF( Zone_Count__c >1, "Multiple", IF( Zone1__c=TRUE,"ZONE 1", IF( Zone2__c=TRUE,"ZONE 2",IF( Zone3__c=TRUE,"ZONE 3",IF( Zone4__c=TRUE,"ZONE 4",IF( Zone5__c=TRUE,"ZONE 5",IF( Zone6__c=TRUE,"ZONE 6","TBD")))))))
CustomField.label: Zone
